facts.text: I am planning a baby gift for my cousin Rachel's baby boy Jack.
I visited Rachel at the hospital after she gave birth to Jack.
I think a diaper cake would be a great idea for the baby gift.
I plan to order the diaper cake from Amazon.
I want help writing a nice gift note to include with the diaper cake.
I want to modify the gift note to remove the phrase about being still smiling thinking about the tiny fingers and toes seen at the hospital.
I plan to include a gift note that starts with "Dear Rachel and Jack,".
I plan to include a gift note that says "So thrilled to welcome you to the family, little Jack!"
I plan to include a gift note that mentions visiting Rachel at the hospital and being on cloud nine.
I plan to include a gift note that says the diaper cake is a small gift to help navigate diaper duty ahead.
I plan to include a gift note that says "Love, [Your Name]".
I want suggestions for a baby carrier or sling for Rachel as an additional gift.
